mutations.contract: apps/viewer/vocab.gen.js is exactly what scripts/generate_js_vocabulary.py writes today. A Python vocabulary that moved with nobody regenerating leaves the two apps rendering the OLD word, which is the drift twenty-six hand copies and three pairing modules used to be arranged against.
mutations.note: The first of the two directions this guard replaced the pairing modules to cover: Python moved, the generated file did not. Mutating VERDICTS rather than a vocabulary with no live instances on purpose -- `marginal` is rendered on real studies, so the mutation is the shape of a real rename rather than a synthetic one. Enrolled with the guard, 2026-09-23 (js_vocabulary_generated_from_python).

mutations.contract: A hand edit to apps/viewer/vocab.gen.js is red on its own. The file says GENERATED at the top; the words in it belong to the Python definition named beside each one, and an edit here is a change nobody can find from the owning side.
mutations.note: The second direction, and the one that had NO analogue before generation: editing a hand copy was only wrong once it disagreed with Python, so there was nothing to catch an edit as such. `budget` is picked because VERDICT_SCOPES is short enough that the whole array is one unique line.
